intent.raw: Define, design, and plan a reusable graph composability and test derivation evidence spine.
intent.objective: Make one Rule --enforces--> Operation example traverse graph, node, edge, obligation, test case, binding, evaluator, and receipt boundaries.
intent.operator_sentence: Author define/design/plan artifacts only; do not execute the first SWU or change release state.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The user requested governed artifact authoring, not delegated execution; local role simulation is enough for planning.
context: The first executable unit is one Task Session SWU.
subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: No subagent execution is authorized by this dispatch.

steps.name: Define artifact contracts and evidence boundary
stop_conditions: the request expands beyond the named artifact classes

steps.name: Design the six-view architecture and interfaces
stop_conditions: a view introduces an unapproved authority

steps.name: Reduce the plan to one reversible first SWU
stop_conditions: more than one SWU is selected
a required acceptance field is missing

steps.name: Hand one selected SWU to Task Session without executing it

outputs.ref: future Task Session receipt for SWU-GCP-001

stop_conditions: Task Session selects a second SWU

gates.condition: Canonical definitions, source graphs, release state, and Inventory authority remain unchanged.
Only SWU-GCP-001 is eligible for the next handoff.
Receipts claim only the selected structural/local proof boundary.

stop_conditions: A design or plan artifact claims semantic satisfiability without a formal evaluator.
A generated read model is treated as source authority.
A second SWU or broad backend wave is executed before the first receipt.
A receipt is missing input digests, residue, or an owner handoff.

observability.signal_grouping: Group evidence by dispatch ID, SWU ID, source digest, graph digest, and receipt ID.

boundaries.to_owner: derived graph, obligation, test, evaluator, and receipt namespaces
boundaries.contract: The invoke package may reference source authority but does not overwrite it; derived evidence carries source and content digests.
Invoke hands off exactly SWU-GCP-001 and does not execute it or promote its result.

authority.lifecycle: invoke authors define/design/plan; task-session owns one bounded execution
authority.validation: dispatch validator plus repository checks in the future Task Session
authority.evidence: receipts bound to source, graph, fixture, and command digests
authority.promotion: no promotion authority in this package
